g.text: Switch this screen between dark and light display themes.

g.text: Which monitor this screen goes to when it is powered on.

g.data-name: stat_label · Off leaves it as a window — which is wha

g.text: Off leaves it as a window — which is what you want while there is only one monitor, so the control panel never ends up behind it.

g.text: Choose what the project touchscreen shows.

g.text: Manage the 3D robot model and subsystem definitions.

g.data-name: stat_label · Export from Onshape: right-click assembl

g.text: GLTF/GLB (single file, preserve hierarchy). For faster loading, pick a coarser tessellation — fine detail balloons the file.

g.data-name: stat_label · If the robot appears tipped on its side,

g.text: If the robot appears tipped on its side, pick the axis that points up in your CAD export and Save — it re-orients instantly, no reload needed.

g.data-name: stat_label · Run uv run scripts/setup_cad_assets.py o

g.text: Run uv run scripts/setup_cad_assets.py once to download Three.js / GSAP offline libs.

g.text: No subsystems yet — click '+ Add Subsystem' to define one.
